name: Fushigi no Umi no Nadia ~Inherit the Blue Water~
original_name: ふしぎの海のナディア ～Inherit the Blue Water～
source:
Game starts off at the Paris Exposition Universelle (World's Fair) in 1889 where the Eiffel Tower is unveiled to the masses and serves as the gateway into the Fair. The protagonist takes a train to the venue and eventually meets up with Nadia and cohorts. After an encounter with a pair of hoodlums and their redheaded mistress, Nadia and player are inducted into the crew of a submarine named the Eltrium.

Part interactive adventure and full-blown submarine action game, Nadia serves as an engrossing experience for fans of the animation.

[Edited from [url=https://psxdatacenter.com/psx2/games2/SLPM-66112.html]Psxdatacenter[/url]]
translation:
游戏从1889年巴黎世界博览会开始，埃菲尔铁塔在这里揭幕，并成为进入博览会的入口。主人公乘火车前往会场，最终与娜迪亚一行人会合。在遭遇一对恶棍及其红发女主人后，娜迪亚与玩家加入了名为“埃尔特里乌姆”的潜艇船员队伍。

这是一部互动冒险与完整潜艇动作游戏的结合，为动画粉丝带来引人入胜的体验。

（改编自：[url=https://psxdatacenter.com/psx2/games2/SLPM-66112.html]Psxdatacenter[/url]）
